function webglContext(

Defined in: core/utils/canvas/webgl-mode.ts:69

canvas.getContext('webgl') + the 'experimental-webgl' alias in one call. Returns null in fallback mode without touching the canvas at all — a canvas that failed getContext('webgl') once can never hand it out again, so probing must be skipped entirely, not faked.
